MOLTBOOK_API_KEY.description: Moltbook agent API key (moltbook_...) from POST https://www.moltbook.com/api/v1/agents/register + claim. Required.

LLM_API_KEY.description: LLM API key (Anthropic or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint). Generates posts + solves anti-spam challenges. Required.

LLM_BASE_URL.description: LLM API base URL. Anthropic-compatible or OpenAI-compatible (the client appends /v1).

LLM_MODEL.description: LLM model name used for post generation and challenge solving.

AGENT_NAME.description: Bot persona name — shown on the dashboard and used in post prompts.

DEFAULT_SUBMOLT.description: Submolt the bot posts into by default.

POST_INTERVAL_MIN.description: Minutes between posts. 240 = every 4h, safe for Moltbook cooldowns (2h new agents, 30min established).

TEMPLATES_JSON.description: Deprecated — use PRODUCTS_JSON. Still accepted for backwards compatibility.

DRY_RUN.description: 1 = generate posts but do NOT publish (review on dashboard). Set 0 to publish for real.

DATA_DIR.description: State directory. Keep /data — matches the attached Railway volume mount.

PRODUCTS_JSON.description: Optional. Inline JSON array [{name, description, category, url?}] of digital products to market — APIs, tools, templates, anything. Empty = built-in defaults. Legacy TEMPLATES_JSON also accepted.

BLOG_CROSSPOST.description: Master switch for cross-publishing posts to Blogger and Dev.to. Set 0 to disable even with credentials present.

BLOGGER_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth2 Client ID for the Blogger API. Optional — leave blank to disable Blogger cross-posting.

BLOGGER_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Google OAuth2 Client Secret (pairs with BLOGGER_CLIENT_ID).

BLOGGER_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: Google OAuth2 refresh token (obtained once out-of-band with access_type=offline&prompt=consent; the bot only refreshes).

BLOGGER_BLOG_ID.description: Numeric Blogger blog ID (from the blog's URL or the Blogger dashboard).

BLOGGER_LABELS.description: Optional comma-separated Blogger labels applied to every cross-posted entry (e.g. Tech,AI Agents).

BLOGGER_IS_DRAFT.description: Set 1 to create Blogger posts as unpublished drafts instead of publishing immediately.

DEVTO_API_KEY.description: Dev.to (Forem) API key from dev.to/settings/extensions. Optional — leave blank to disable Dev.to cross-posting.

DEVTO_TAGS.description: Optional comma-separated Dev.to tags, MAX 4 (the API rejects 5+; crypto-related tags are auto-stripped).

DEVTO_PUBLISHED.description: Set 0 to save Dev.to articles as drafts; defaults to publishing immediately.

DEVTO_ORGANIZATION.description: Optional Dev.to organization slug to publish under instead of the personal account.
